Nothing But a Man has the violence, passion, tenderness of a Negro man and a girl in a smoldering southern town!

33920: After his wife Emily is murdered, widower Adam Chaplin calls upon supernatural forces to help enact his brutal revenge.
Nothing can prepare you for this extreme fight.
34176: Karthik, an unwavering idealist, goes on a journey to restore harmony in the fractured family and prove himself, when his pursuit of justice inadvertently clashes with family loyalty.

Older than Bones. Darker than Blood. Stronger than Science.
34688: A has-been rock star that discovers he has a teenage daughter from a long forgotten love affair.
Olivia just met the perfect man for her mom...her dad.
34944: A bullied teenager who is locked up at a juvenile detention center due to an unexpected accident, meets a mixed martial arts champion to break through his own limits.
A boy who never knew how to fight back.
35200: Unlike in the previous sequel of "Foolish Years"/"Zika's Dynasty" film series, Zika's and Milan's grandson became crazy for girls, having sex with them simultaneously in his apartment. Granddads are now worried for different reason, so they visit the doctor who gives them an advice to send their grandson to the country in order to use his strength appropriately.
35456: Croatia, seven years after bankruptcy. There is a fight going on in the world - water has become more precious than oil. My heroes were never turned into statues. They died fighting against the ones who were.
35968: A dying Doctor, who plans to check out on his own terms, takes a reluctant detour when he inadvertently winds up on the lam with an 'anything-but-normal' 22-year-old girl.
He wanted a peaceful trip. He got her instead.

36480: A wealthy man hires a poor girl to play his mistress in order to get more attention from his neglectful family.
From park bench to parkside mansion in a riot of romantic complications and Hi-Hat Hilarity!
36736: A woman turns her sister's belated birthday celebration into an intervention, but as events unfold, it becomes unclear which sibling needs the most help.
A movie about adulation and malice.
36992: Biopic of Louis Cyr, strongest man in the world at the end of the 19th Century.
37248: An opportunistic music producer brings together a rabbi, a priest, and an imam to preach about peaceful coexistence through song. But he's in for a surprise when he realizes the religious leaders are far from saints.
37504: A college student joins a group of revolutionaries to meet girls but ends up committed to their goals.
They're young and feel everything more deeply... and there's so much to feel deeply about.
37760: Set in a small island village of Yedurulanka,  faces the looming uncertainties of 2012, Shiva, a pragmatic youngster along with his girlfriend Chithra and friends, devise a scheme to disprove the end of the world theory and expose the plan by the trio of fake god-men, to fleece the people.
38016: A young woman is held captive in an underground medical facility where selected individuals are perpetually mutilated and then healed using an experimental miracle drug: a panacea.
38272: The third part of Seventh Company adventures.
Tassin, ouvrier aux abattoirs de Nice
Mme Paul Suzanne Chaudard, fille d'instituteur
Lambert, chef de la milice française locale
M. Albert, le passeur qui ne parle pas Anglais
38528: A cannibal hermit living in the woods preys on campers and hikers for his food supply.
38784: Returning home after disappearing three years ago, former gunslinger Lorn Warfield finds that an Apache raiding party has kidnapped his wife and children. They had one enemy even more deadly than the Apaches... each other!
39040: An elite group of Chinese pilots must take part in a dangerous mission to thwart a terrorist plot and resolve a hostage situation.
39296: The passengers of a luxury airliner become stranded on a remote, mysterious island after an emergency landing. They soon realize the island holds a dark, deadly secret.
39552: In postwar Sweden, a gifted young pianist’s life is transformed after a tragic accident leaves him blind. From the World's Master Film Maker Ingmar Bergman a startling journey into the darkness of the human soul!
39808: Terry Sugury is hired to recover one of two tapes containing a formula for making heroin for a price of 200 dollars a pound. But he gets double crossed. So he wants the tape back.
When getting even isn't good enough!

More fun than you can handle!

A War Begins With The Summit For Peace.

The runaway begins...
41088: When hard partying and volatile neighbours move in next door, a quiet woman's life begins to spiral, pushing her to the edge and triggering a slow, unnerving descent into obsession and revenge.
41344: Set in tsarist Russia around the turn of the century and based on a true story of a Russian Jewish peasant Yakov Bog who was wrongly imprisoned for a most unlikely crime - the “ritual murder” of a Gentile child in Kyiv. They accused him… They beat him… They condemned him… and after all that, they were more afraid of him than ever.
41600: They were looking for the ultimate getaway, they planned for the perfect paradise vacation; what they’re about to get is a trip no one is prepared for. Robbed by their tour guide and left for dead, the girls take shelter in a deserted Mexican resort that is haunted by the unspeakable atrocities of past.
41856: A troubled man runs away to Mexico and is recruited to join a paramilitary group of teens fighting the drug cartels. He proves himself to the group, but questions their motive.
No Home. No Laws. No Limits.

While the election machinery is quickly started and soon picks up speed, only two questions remain unanswered: Is Horst Schlämmer ready for Germany? And is Germany ready for him?
Horst Schlämmer / Uschi Blum / Gisela / Angela Merkel / Ronald Profalla / Ulla Schmidt
42624: Misa in the music school falls in love with a young Russian girl Natasha, who was then located in Belgrade. But their parents think that they are too young for love. Zika begins to learn the Russian language.
42880: Anna and Thomas are missing something: love. They will follow their encounter through confusing crushes and lack of commitment, but can love survive when you don't want to compromise your own dreams for your partner?

She gets what she wants. She keeps what she gets. She never lets go.

A legend in her own words.

Pity the men in her life!

Years later, thanks to the protection of a corrupt politician, she becomes the main "madame" of San Francisco, in addition to participating in various illegal activities.
My Record's Perfect Now!...Ten Commandments and I've Broken Every One of Them!

However, the child's birth there will also provide a solution to a very important problem for the townspeople.
45184: Sgt. Mike Kincaid of the French Foreign Legion learns, from a Riff prisoner, that an attack will soon be made by the villainous Hussin on the Legion's outpost of Tarfa. Hussin forcefully takes her back, but by now his planned attack on Tarfa is crumbling and Mahla has begun to fall in love with Kincaid.

45696: The adventures of high schoolers, including strict maths teachers, rock 'n' roll music, and first love experiences.

46208: In this drama that alludes to the Algerian War with France of the 1960s, Thomas is a deserter from the French Foreign Legion who is on the run from authorities. Dominique gives Thomas money to escape to France after he secures her freedom, but he is caught between the Foreign Legion and the terrorists seeking revenge.
Have I The Right to Kill?
46464: Rising, rather autobiographical novelist Giph has a hot girlfriend, doctor and model Samarinde. His crude, domineering and progressive mother Ria's suffering an incurable decease in which she suffers from paraplegia. Her inevitably ensuing death is brought forward with euthanasia. Giph is struggling to handle the situation with his mother. Shortly after his mother has passed he away, he decides to join his fun loving friends on La Palma for a holiday. There Samarinde tells her boyfriend she's expecting his baby
46720: An attorney with a military past hunts down the gang who killed his wife and took his daughter.
46976: After waking from a coma, Tino learns his future in-laws have given him a high-powered financial job, for which he is woefully unqualified.
47232: Hakan and Esra are a married couple in their mid-thirties. They are both uncertain about having a baby, but life has a surprise for them.
This is a real story... Because it belongs to all of us.

The team running it tries to resist the deterioration and dehumanisation of psychiatry as best as they can.
47744: Rodrigo and Rocco join their families to hold a birthday party for their grandfather. Rodrigo is a regular middle-class teenager, while Rocco is rather more unconventional, indie magazine writer, and has deep conflicts with his father.

To save Rufus' magical world, Scott and Emily must face many exciting challenges...

After thirteen years in prison, Billy McCain thought he'd met up with everything, until he met up with his own daughter Jonsy.
49024: Ayça and Hama Ali are together in spirit, but divided by geography. With the outbreak of the Iraq War leaving him stranded, she embarks on an odyssey from Turkey to be reunited with him.

49536: Ocho is accidentally captured by a drug trafficking cartel who use Chinese women to smuggle drugs into Japan by hiding it in their vaginas. She is tortured, and manages to escape, fighting both the male yakuzas and a gang of female thieves.

Meanwhile Chip's father hires a detective to find out the truth, and Chip's friend Fred gets Silver's sister in trouble at a drag race. Silver has a lot of problems all right.
WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOUTHFUL REBELS GO BAD?

Leda (Jane March) is a successful woman who works as Head of the Public Relations for a big company. She's married to Alceo, a professor at the Sapienza University, specialized in the history of terrorist movements. Alceo is on a wheel chair. He lost his legs in the attack to the American Embassy in Nairobi in 1998. Shahid is a terrorist. Now he's planning an attack along the English Channel. Their lives, their destinies cross in Turkey, where Leda and Alceo are on holiday. And the plot will go on to Rome and Turin till the epilogue of the attack on the ferry boat.

He spends his days at home, having declined his son’s invitation to come to the United States. Then a friend shows him a help-wanted ad. Although he has never published a book, Tarini used to tell made-up stories to his friends in his youth, and the ad for a storyteller in Ahmedabad in western India piques his interest.
51072: Given the chance to live in a simulated underwater home for a month, a scientist convinces his family to take advantage of the offer. Once the family agrees to move in, underwater mayhem occurs!
A combo of scuba dupes rock up a storm in a mad pad under the surf!

Three strangers. One city. No way out.

He loves practical jokes, but this time he might have gone too far...
